# Fixed GUI-facing slot triggers. Each route dispatches by the slot's stable task ID.
tv_conquest_task_slot_1_display_trigger = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_id ?= 0 }
		custom_tooltip = { text = TV_VICTORY_TASK_NO_AVAILABLE_REQUIREMENT always = no }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_id ?= 1001 }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_VICTORY_TASK_1001_CONQUEST_1_REQUIREMENT
			OR = {
				has_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_complete
				var:tv_victory_task_metric_total_locations ?= { this >= var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_target }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_id ?= 1002 }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_VICTORY_TASK_1002_CONQUEST_1_REQUIREMENT
			OR = {
				has_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_complete
				var:tv_victory_task_metric_owned_locations ?= { this >= var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_target }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_id ?= 1003 }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_VICTORY_TASK_1003_CONQUEST_1_REQUIREMENT
			OR = {
				has_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_complete
				var:tv_victory_task_metric_colonial_locations ?= { this >= var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_target }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_id ?= 1101 }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_VICTORY_TASK_1101_CONQUEST_1_REQUIREMENT
			OR = {
				has_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_complete
				tv_victory_task_1101_current_condition = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_id ?= 1102 }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_VICTORY_TASK_1102_CONQUEST_1_REQUIREMENT
			OR = {
